title: Sanlorenzo SL86
highlights: One owner since new, only 490 engine hours
41 m² flybridge with electric opening sunroof
Bespoke Canaletto walnut interior, Silk Georgette marble bathrooms
Twin MTU 12V 2000 M96L, 32 knots top speed
Fin stabilisers, bow and stern thrusters, watermaker
Tender garage accessible from the transom
description:
A 2018 Sanlorenzo SL86 in private ownership since new, with only 490 engine hours and a full list of shipyard extras, now offered for sale in Istanbul, Turkey.

Designed by Officina Italiana Design under Mauro Micheli, the SL86 is the flagship of Sanlorenzo's SL flybridge range. Her 41 m² hardtop flybridge, one of the largest at this size, hosts a dining area, a wet bar with Teppan Yaki grill, sun lounging and an electric opening sunroof.

This example features a bespoke Canaletto walnut interior throughout, with white lacquered walls in the saloon and Silk Georgette marble in every bathroom. Four en-suite cabins sleep eight guests, including a full-beam owner's stateroom with walk-in dressing room, and two crew cabins accommodate three.

Twin MTU 12V 2000 M96L engines of 1,950 HP each give a top speed of 32 knots and a 26-knot cruise. Contact Yacht Research for the full specification and viewing arrangements.
